svg.title: Reef: colony seating and school loops
svg.desc: Golden-angle seats of a coral colony, and the paths of a school of ten fish at low and high CPU (a replica of the steering rule).
svg.text: Seats: r = 1.6 sqrt(k + 0.5), angle = k * 137.5 deg
dot size = stalk height 1.5 + 5 (1 - d / room): a dome
largest swing of the centre past the target: 2.5
largest swing of the centre past the target: 3.4
gold = the school's centre (a driven undamped oscillator), blue = the fish's paths over 40 s, dots = positions at 40 s
Equal and opposite separation and alignment terms leave only the pull toward the circling target to move the centre.
